55.fa: خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی به پیامبرش (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَما أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ؛ خداوند تصمیم گرفت که اهل زمین را عذاب کند بعد برای خدا بداء حاصل شد و رحمت نازل گردید، فرمود: «ای محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله)! و پیوسته تذکّر ده، زیرا تذکّر مؤمنان را سود می‌بخشد».
55.en: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): "So turn away from them, for you are not to be blamed." He intended to punish the people of the earth, then a bada' (a change in the manifestation of the divine decree) occurred for Allah, and mercy descended. He then said: "And remind, O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers."
55.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 150
55.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 26, p. 164; Basa'ir al-Darajat, p. 110

55.ar: هَمَّ اللَّهُ جَلَّ ذِکْرُهُ بِهَلَاکِ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فَأَنْزَلَ عَلَی رَسُولِهِ فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَما أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ ثُمَّ بَدَاءَ لَهُ فِی ذَلِکَ فَأَنْزَلَ عَلَیْهِ وَ ذَکِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّکْری تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ.
55.fa: خداوند تصمیم داشت مردم روی زمین را هلاک نماید به حضرت محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «تو از آن‌ها فاصله بگیر، سرزنش نخواهی شد». بعد در این مورد بداء حاصل شد و این آیه را نازل نمود: وَ ذَکِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّکْری تَنْفَعُ المُؤْمِنِینَ.
55.en: Allah, whose mention is exalted, intended to destroy the people of the earth, so He revealed to His Messenger: "So turn away from them, O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), for you are not to be blamed." Then, a change of will (bada') occurred for Him regarding that, and He revealed to him: "And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers."
55.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 150
55.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 239; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 330; [with slight variations]

55.ar: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عِلْمَیْنِ عِلْماً مَخْزُوناً مَکْنُوناً لَا یَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا هُوَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ یَکُونُ الْبَدَاءُ وَ عِلْماً عَلَّمَهُ مَلَائِکَتَهُ وَ رُسُلَهُ فَالْعُلَمَاءُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَیْتِ نَبِیِّکَ یَعْلَمُونَهُ قَالَ سُلَیْمَانُ أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَنْزِعَهُ لِی مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ قَالَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لِنَبِیِّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَما أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ أَرَادَ إِهْلَاکَهُمْ ثُمَّ بَدَا فَقَالَ وَ ذَکِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّکْری تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ.
55.fa: به سلیمان مروزی فرمود: خدای عزّوجلّ را دو علم است؛ یکی علم مخزون و مکنونی که در خزینه شده و از هرکسی پوشیده و کسی غیر از خدا آن را نمی‌داند و بداء از آن می‌باشد و علمی دیگر که آن را به فرشتگان و پیغمبرانش (علیهم السلام) تعلیم فرموده، پس علمای از اهل‌بیت پیغمبرش (علیهم السلام) آن را می‌دانند. سلیمان گفت: «دوست دارم که این را از کتاب خدای عزّوجلّ برایم استخراج کنی». حضرت (علیه السلام) فرمود: «سخن خدای عزّوجلّ به پیغمبرش (صلی الله علیه و آله): فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَما أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ و حضرت (علیه السلام) فرمود: «هلاک ایشان را اراده فرمود بعد از آن از برای خدا بداء شد و فرمود: وَ ذَکِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّکْری تَنْفَعُ الْمؤْمِنِینَ».
55.en: Verily, Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) has two types of knowledge: a stored and hidden knowledge which none knows except Him, and from this comes the Bada’ (divine alteration of a decree); and a knowledge which He has taught to His angels and His messengers, and the scholars from the Household of your Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) know it. Sulayman said, "I would like you to extract this for me from the Book of Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He)." He (peace be upon him) said, "It is the saying of Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): 'So turn away from them, for you are not to be blamed' (51:54). He intended their destruction, then a Bada’ occurred, so He said: 'And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers' (51:55)."
55.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 150
55.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 4, p. 95; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 10, p. 330; Al-Tawhid, p. 441; ‘Uyun Akhbar al-Rida (a), Vol. 1, p. 179

56.ar: عَنْ جَمِیلِ بْنِ دَرَّاج قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ الصّادق (علیه السلام) جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ مَا مَعْنَی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ فَقَالَ خَلَقَهُمْ لِلْعِبَادَةِ.
56.fa: جمیل‌بن‌درّاج گوید: به امام صادق (علیه السلام) عرض کردم: «فدایت شوم! معنای آیه: ومَا خَلقْتُ الجِنَّ والإِنسَ إِلا لیَعْبُدُونِ چیست»؟ فرمود: «آن‌ها را برای عبادت آفریده است».
56.en: Jamil ibn Darraj said: I said to Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), "May I be made your sacrifice, what is the meaning of the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me'?" He replied, "He created them for worship."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152
56.refs: Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 1, p. 83 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 314 / 'Ilal al-Sharayi', Vol. 1, p. 13 / Al-Burhan

56.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَالَ خَلَقَهُمْ لِیَأْمُرَهُمْ بِالْعِبَادَةِ.
56.fa: ابوبصیر گوید: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) از [تفسیر] این آیه: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ پرسیدم. فرمود: «یعنی ایشان را خلق نموده تا امر به عبادتش کند».
56.en: Abu Basir said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me." He said: "He created them so that He might command them to worship."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152
56.refs: 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 13; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 1, p. 84; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 313; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 1, p. 121; Al-'Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 164 [with the word "li-ya'murahum" omitted]; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 318

56.ar: عَنْ جَمِیلِ بْنِ دَرَّاج قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ الصّادق (علیه السلام) أَصْلَحَکَ اللَّهُ وَ لا یَرْضی لِعِبادِهِ الْکُفْرَ قَالَ فَقَالَ الصّادق (علیه السلام) النَّاسُ جَمِیعاً لَمْ یَرْضَ لَهُمُ الْکُفْرَ قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَالَ فَقَالَ الصّادق (علیه السلام) خَلَقَهُمْ لِلْعِبَادَةِ.
56.fa: جمیل‌بن‌درّاج گوید: به امام صادق (علیه السلام) عرض کردم: فدایت شوم! ومَا خَلقْتُ الجِنَّ و الإِنسَ إِلا لیَعْبُدُونِ. گوید: امام (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آن‌ها را برای عبادت خلق کرد».
56.en: Jamil ibn Darraj said: I said to Abu Abd Allah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), "May Allah set you right, and He does not approve of disbelief for His servants." Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said, "He did not approve of disbelief for all of mankind." I said, "May I be made your sacrifice, [what about the verse] 'And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me'?" He (peace be upon him) said, "He created them for worship."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152

56.ar: عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَعْیَنَ قَالَ: تَفَکَّرْتُ فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قُلْتُ خُلِقُوا لِلْعِبَادَةِ وَ یَعْصُونَ وَ یَعْبُدُونَ غَیْرَهُ وَ اللَّهِ لَأَسْأَلَنَّ جَعْفَراً عَنْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةِ فَأَتَیْتُ الْبَابَ فَجَلَسْتُ أُرِیدُ الدُّخُولَ عَلَیْهِ إِذْ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ فَقَرَأَ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ لا تَدْرِی لَعَلَّ اللهَ یُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذلِکَ أَمْراً فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهَا مَنْسُوخَةٌ.
56.fa: داودبن‌اعین گوید: من در سخن الهی: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ، تفکّر می‌کردم که گفتم: «خلق برای عبادت مخلوق شده‌اند و حال آنکه از آن‌ها گناه سر می‌زند. و بعضی غیر او را می‌پرستند. به خدا سوگند که من دلیل این آیه را از امام صادق (علیه السلام) سؤال خواهم کرد، به در خانه‌ی امام صادق (علیه السلام) آمدم و خواستم که وارد شوم، صدایش را بلند کرد و خواند: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ و بعد از آن نیز خواند: «لا تَدْرِی لَعَلَّ اللهَ یُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذلِکَ أَمْراً پس من دانستم».
56.en: Dawud ibn A'yan said: I was reflecting on the words of the Almighty, "I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me," and I said to myself, "They were created for worship, yet they commit sins and worship others besides Him. By God, I will certainly ask Ja'far about this verse." I came to the door and sat down, intending to enter, when he raised his voice and recited, "I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me," and then he recited, "You do not know; perhaps God will bring about a new matter after that." Thus, I realized that it [the first verse] was abrogated.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 47, p. 148; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 318; Kashf al-Ghummah, Vol. 2, p. 199

56.ar: عَنْ جَمِیلِ بْنِ دَرَّاج قَالَ سَأَلْتُ إمام الصّادق (علیه السلام) عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَالَ خَلَقَهُمْ لِلْعِبَادَةِ قُلْتُ خَاصَّةً أَمْ عَامَّةً قَالَ لَا بَلْ عَامَّةً.
56.fa: جمیل‌بن‌درّاج گوید: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) پرسیدم: «اینکه خداوند می‌فرماید: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ؛ معنی آن چیست»؟ حضرت (علیه السلام) فرمود: «خداوند مردم را برای عبادت نمودن خلق نمود». عرض کردم: «عبادت خاص یا عام»؟ فرمود: «عام».
56.en: Jamil ibn Darraj said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me." He said: "He created them for worship." I said: "Is it specific or general?" He said: "No, rather it is general."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 314; ‘Ilal al-Shara’i’, Vol. 1, p. 14; Al-Burhan; Wasa’il al-Shi’ah, Vol. 1, p. 84

56.ar: عَن ابْنِ أَبِی عُمَیْر قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَاالْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) عَنْ مَعْنَی قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) «الشَّقِیُّ مَنْ شَقِیَ فِی بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ وَ السَّعِیدُ مَنْ سَعِدَ فِی بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ فَقَالَ الشَّقِیُّ مَنْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ وَ هُوَ فِی بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَنَّهُ سَیَعْمَلُ أَعْمَالَ الْأَشْقِیَاءِ وَ السَّعِیدُ مَنْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ وَ هُوَ فِی بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَنَّهُ سَیَعْمَلُ أَعْمَالَ السُّعَدَاءِ» قُلْتُ لَهُ (علیه السلام) فَمَا مَعْنَی قَوْلِهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) اعْمَلُوا فَکُلٌّ مُیَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ خَلَقَ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ لِیَعْبُدُوهُ وَ لَمْ یَخْلُقْهُمْ لِیَعْصُوهُ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عزّوجلّ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ فَیَسَّرَ کُلًّا لِمَا خَلَقَ لَهُ فَالْوَیْلُ لِمَنِ اسْتَحَبَّ الْعَمَی عَلَی الْهُدَی. سَأَلْتُ أَبَاالْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) عَنْ مَعْنَی قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ... اعْمَلُوا فَکُلٌّ مُیَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَه. فَقَالَ (علیه السلام) إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ خَلَقَ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ لِیَعْبُدُوهُ وَ لَمْ یَخْلُقْهُمْ لِیَعْصُوهُ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ فَیَسَّرَ کُلًّا لِمَا خَلَقَ لَهُ فَالْوَیْلُ لِمَنِ اسْتَحَبَّ الْعَمَی عَلَی الْهُدَی.
56.fa: ابن‌أبی‌عمیر گوید: از امام موسی (علیه السلام) نقل شده است که درباره‌ی کلام رسول خدا (علیه السلام) که می‌فرماید: ...عمل کنید، زیرا هرکس برای انجام دادن آنچه برای آن خلق شده است، توانا است، فرمود: «خداوند عزّوجلّ، جنّ و انس را خلق کرده که او را بپرستند و آن‌ها را خلق نکرده‌تا از او نافرمانی کنند و این کلام خداوند متعال است که می‌فرماید: و مَا خَلقْتُ الجِنَّ و الإِنسَ إِلا لیَعْبُدُونِ و هرچیزی را که برای او خلق شده است آسان گردانید. پس وای! بر کسی که کوری و ضلالت را به‌جای هدایت دوست داشته باشد و برگزیند».
56.en: Ibn Abi Umayr said: I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him) about the meaning of the saying of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family): "The wretched one is he who was wretched in his mother's womb, and the happy one is he who was happy in his mother's womb." He (peace be upon him) said: "The wretched one is he whom Allah knew, while he was in his mother's womb, that he would perform the deeds of the wretched, and the happy one is he whom Allah knew, while he was in his mother's womb, that he would perform the deeds of the happy." I said to him (peace be upon him): "Then what is the meaning of his (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) saying: 'Act, for everyone is facilitated for that which he was created for'?" He (peace be upon him) said: "Indeed, Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, created the jinn and mankind so that they might worship Him, and He did not create them so that they might disobey Him. That is the meaning of His saying, the Almighty and Majestic: 'And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me' (51:56). Thus, He facilitated each for that which He created them for. So, woe to the one who prefers blindness over guidance."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 152
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 157; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 64, p. 119; Al-Tawhid, p. 356; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

56.ar: ... أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِبَعْضِ تَلَامِیذِهِ یَوْماً أَیَ شَیْءٍ تَعَلَّمْتَ مِنِّی قَالَ لَهُ یَا مَوْلَایَ ثَمَانَ مَسَائِلَ قَالَ قُصَّهَا عَلَیَّ لِأَعْرِفَهَا قَالَ ... السَّابِعَةُ قَالَ رَأَیْتُ کَدْحَ النَّاسِ وَ اجْتِهَادَهُمْ فِی طَلَبِ الرِّزْقِ وَ سَمِعْتُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَی وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ. ما أُرِیدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَ ما أُرِیدُ أَنْ یُطْعِمُونِ. إِنَّ اللهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِینُ فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ وَعْدَهُ حَقٌّ وَ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَی صِدْقٌ فَسَکَنْتُ إِلَی وَعْدِهِ وَ رَضِیتُ بِقَوْلِهِ وَ اشْتَغَلْتُ بِمَا لَهُ عَلَیَّ عَمَّا لِی عِنْدَهُ قَالَ أَحْسَنْتَ وَ اللَّه.
56.fa: روزی به یکی از شاگردانش فرمود: «از من چه‌چیزی آموختی»؟ عرض کرد: «آقا! من از شما هشت مسأله یاد گرفتم». حضرت (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آن‌ها را بیان کن تا بدانم». ... عرض کرد: «هفتم؛ دیدم مردم در طلب روزی سخت در تلاش و کوششند و من گوش به این آیه مبارکه دادم که می‌فرماید: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ، ما أُرِیدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَ ما أُرِیدُ أَنْ یُطْعِمُونِ إِنَّ اللهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِینُ و یقین دانستم که وعده و گفتار او راست است، پس دل به وعده او بستم و به فرموده او راضی شدم، و به جای آنچه من نزد او دارم [روزیم]، به حقّی که او بر عهده من دارد سرگرم شدم. امام (علیه السلام) فرمود: به خدا قسم، کار نیکی کرده‌ای»!
56.en: One day, he (peace be upon him) said to one of his students, "What have you learned from me?" The student replied, "O my master, eight matters." He said, "Relate them to me so that I may know them." ... The student said, "The seventh: I saw the toil and striving of people in seeking sustenance, and I heard the words of the Almighty: 'And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me. I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me. Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.' I knew that His promise is true and His word is the truth, so I found tranquility in His promise, became content with His word, and occupied myself with what He has required of me, rather than what I have from Him. The Imam (peace be upon him) said, 'By Allah, you have done well.'"
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154
56.refs: Irshad al-Qulub, Vol. 1, p. 187; Majmu'at Warram, Vol. 1, p. 303

56.ar: عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: خَرَجَ الْحُسَیْنُ بْنُ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) عَلَی أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ ذِکْرُهُ مَا خَلَقَ الْعِبَادَ إِلَّا لِیَعْرِفُوهُ فَإِذَا عَرَفُوهُ عَبَدُوهُ فَإِذَا عَبَدُوهُ اسْتَغْنَوْا بِعِبَادَتِهِ عَنْ عِبَادَةِ مَنْ سِوَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ بِأَبِی أَنْتَ وَ أُمِّی فَمَا مَعْرِفَةُ اللَّهِ قَالَ مَعْرِفَةُ أَهْلِ کُلِّ زَمَانٍ إِمَامَهُمُ الَّذِی یَجِبُ عَلَیْهِمْ طَاعَتُه.
56.fa: اصحاب من! خداوند مردم را آفرید تا او را بشناسند وقتی شناختند او را می‌پرستند، وقتی او را پرستیدند از پرستش دیگران دست می‌کشند. مردی عرض کرد: «ای پسر رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله)، پدر و مادرم فدایت! معنی معرفت خدا چیست»؟ حضرت فرمود: «اهل هر زمانی، معرفت و شناخت امام زمان خودشان است که اطاعتش بر آن‌ها واجب می‌باشد».
56.en: Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) narrated: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) went out to his companions and said: "O people, Allah, the Majestic is His remembrance, did not create the servants except that they might know Him. When they know Him, they worship Him, and when they worship Him, they become, by His worship, independent of the worship of anyone else." A man said to him, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, may my father and mother be sacrificed for you, what is the knowledge (ma'rifah) of Allah?" He replied, "It is the knowledge of the people of every time regarding their Imam, whose obedience is obligatory upon them."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154

56.ar: عَنْ یَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَیْبٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَالَ خَلَقَهُمْ لِلْعِبَادَةِ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ قَوْلُهُ لا یَزالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِینَ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّکَ وَ لِذلِکَ خَلَقَهُمْ فَقَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ بَعْدَ تِلْک.
56.en: Ya’qub ibn Shu’ayb narrated that he asked Abu ‘Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me." He said: "He created them for worship." I said: "And what of His saying: 'But they will not cease to differ, except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them'?" He replied: "This verse was revealed after that one."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 318; Nur al-Thaqalayn

56.ar: وَ لَقَدْ سَأَلَ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) شِیعَتَهُ عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذَا ... وَ نَسَخَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَوْلَهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ لا یَزالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِینَ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّکَ وَ لِذلِکَ خَلَقَهُمْ أَیْ لِلرَّحْمَةِ خَلَقَهُم.
56.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) asked his followers about something like this... And the saying of the Almighty, "I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me," was abrogated by His saying, the Almighty and Majestic, "But they will not cease to differ, except whom your Lord has had mercy, and for that He created them," meaning He created them for mercy.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154

56.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ قَالَ خَلَقَهُمْ لِیَأْمُرَهُمْ بِالْعِبَادَةِ قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ لا یَزالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِینَ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّکَ وَ لِذلِکَ خَلَقَهُمْ قَالَ (علیه السلام) خَلَقَهُمْ لِیَفْعَلُوا مَا یَسْتَوْجِبُونَ بِهِ رَحْمَتَهُ فَیَرْحَمَهُمْ.
56.en: Abu Basir said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me." He said: "He created them so that He might command them to worship." He said: And I asked him about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "But they will not cease to differ, except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them." He (peace be upon him) said: "He created them so that they might perform that which would make them deserving of His mercy, so that He might have mercy upon them."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154

56.ar: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُونِ وَ الْوَجْهُ الْآخَرُ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّکُمُ الَّذِی خَلَقَکُمْ وَ الَّذِینَ مِنْ قَبْلِکُمْ أَیِ اعْبُدُوهُ لَعَلَّکُمْ تَتَّقُونَ النَّار.
56.en: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me." The other interpretation is: "Worship your Lord, who created you and those before you" (Al-Baqarah/21). The second meaning is: Worship your Lord who created you and those who came before you, so that you may be protected from the Fire.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 154
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 65, p. 286; [with slight variation] Al-Imam al-Askari, p. 139

56.ar: فی رِسالَتِهِ فِی الرَّدِ عَلَی أهْلِ الْجَبْرِ وَ التَّفْویضِ وَ إثْباتِ الْعَدْلِ وَ الْمَنْزِلَةِ بَیْنَ الْمَنْزِلَتَیْنِ ... یَجِبُ عَلَی هَذَا السَّبَبِ إِمَّا أَنْ یَکُونَ الْمَالِکُ لِلْعَبْدِ قَادِراً یَأْمُرُ عَبْدَهُ بِاتِّبَاعِ أَمْرِهِ وَ نَهْیِهِ عَلَی إِرَادَتِهِ لَا عَلَی إِرَادَةِ الْعَبْدِ وَ یُمَلِّکُهُ مِنَ الطَّاقَةِ بِقَدْرِ مَا یَأْمُرُهُ بِهِ وَ یَنْهَاهُ عَنْهُ فَإِذَا أَمَرَهُ بِأَمْرٍ وَ نَهَاهُ عَنْ نَهْیٍ عَرَّفَهُ الثَّوَابَ وَ الْعِقَابَ عَلَیْهِمَا وَ حَذَّرَهُ وَ رَغَّبَهُ بِصِفَةِ ثَوَابِهِ وَ عِقَابِهِ لِیَعْرِفَ الْعَبْدُ قُدْرَةَ مَوْلَاهُ بِمَا مَلَّکَهُ مِنَ الطَّاقَةِ لِأَمْرِهِ وَ نَهْیِهِ وَ تَرْغِیبِهِ وَ تَرْهِیبِهِ فَیَکُونَ عَدْلُهُ وَ إِنْصَافُهُ شَامِلًا لَهُ وَ حُجَّتُهُ وَاضِحَةً عَلَیْهِ لِلْإِعْذَارِ وَ الْإِنْذَارِ فَإِذَا اتَّبَعَ الْعَبْدُ أَمْرَ مَوْلَاهُ جَازَاهُ وَ إِذَا لَمْ یَزْدَجِرْ عَنْ نَهْیِهِ عَاقَبَهُ أَوْ یَکُونَ عَاجِزاً غَیْرَ قَادِرٍ فَفَوَّضَ أَمْرَهُ إِلَیْهِ أَحْسَنَ أَمْ أَسَاءَ أَطَاعَ أَمْ عَصَی عَاجِزٌ عَنْ عُقُوبَتِهِ وَ رَدَّهُ إِلَی اتِّبَاعِ أَمْرِهِ وَ فِی إِثْبَاتِ الْعَجْزِ نَفْیُ الْقُدْرَةِ وَ التَّأَلُّهِ وَ إِبْطَالُ الْأَمْرِ وَ النَّهْیِ وَ الثَّوَابِ وَ الْعِقَابِ وَ مُخَالَفَةُ الْکِتَابِ إِذْ یَقُولُ وَ لا یَرْضی لِعِبادِهِ الْکُفْرَ وَ إِنْ تَشْکُرُوا یَرْضَهُ لَکُمْ وَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ: اتَّقُوا اللهَ حَقَّ تُقاتِهِ وَ لا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ و قوله: وَ ما خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِیَعْبُدُون.
56.en: In his treatise refuting the proponents of predestination (al-jabr) and delegation (al-tafwid), and establishing Divine Justice and the position between the two positions: ...Must it not be, for this reason, that the Master of the servant is All-Powerful, commanding His servant to follow His command and prohibition according to His own will, not the will of the servant, and granting him the capacity to the extent of what He commands him to do and forbids him from? When He commands him with a matter and forbids him from a prohibition, He makes known to him the reward and punishment for both, warning him and encouraging him through the description of His reward and punishment, so that the servant may know the power of his Master through what He has granted him of capacity for His command, prohibition, encouragement, and intimidation. Thus, His justice and fairness encompass him, and His proof is clear against him for the sake of excuse and warning. If the servant follows the command of his Master, He rewards him, and if he does not desist from His prohibition, He punishes him. Or, is the Master incapable and powerless, having delegated the matter to the servant—whether he does good or evil, obeys or disobeys—being unable to punish him or return him to the following of His command? Proving incapacity negates power and divinity, invalidates command and prohibition, reward and punishment, and contradicts the Book, for He says: "And He does not approve of disbelief for His servants; and if you are grateful, He approves it for you" (39:7), and His saying, the Almighty and Majestic: "Fear Allah as He should be feared, and do not die except as Muslims" (3:102), and His saying: "And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me" (51:56).
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 156

56.ar: خَلَقَهُمْ لِلْأَمْرِ وَ النَّهْیِ وَ التَّکْلِیفِ وَ لَیْسَتْ خِلْقَتُهُمْ جَبْراً أَنْ یَعْبُدُوهُ وَ لَکِنْ خِلْقَتُهُمْ اخْتِیَاراً لِیَخْتَبِرَهُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ وَ النَّهْیِ وَ مَنْ یُطِیعُ وَ مَنْ یَعْصِی. وَ فِی حَدِیثٍ آخَرَ قَالَ: هِیَ مَنْسُوخَةٌ بِقَوْلِهِ: وَ لَا یَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِینَ وَ قَوْلِهِ: مَا أُرِیدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَ إِنِّی لَمْ أَخْلُقْهُمْ لِحَاجَةٍ بِی إِلَیْهِمْ.
56.en: He created them for the command, the prohibition, and the obligation [of religious duties]. Their creation was not by compulsion so that they would worship Him; rather, their creation was by choice, so that He might test them through the command and the prohibition, and [to see] who obeys and who disobeys. In another hadith, he said: It is abrogated by His saying: "But they will not cease to differ" [Hud: 118], and His saying: "I do not want any provision from them," meaning I did not create them out of any need I have for them.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 156
56.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 330; Nur al-Thaqalayn; "And His saying, 'I do not want...'" [the rest is omitted].

56.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لَمَّا أَخْرَجَ ذُرِّیَّةَ آدَمَ (علیه السلام) مِنْ ظَهْرِهِ لِیَأْخُذَ عَلَیْهِمُ الْمِیثَاقَ بِالرُّبُوبِیَّةِ لَهُ وَ بِالنُّبُوَّةِ لِکُلِّ نَبِیٍّ فَکَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَخَذَ لَهُ عَلَیْهِمُ الْمِیثَاقَ بِنُبُوَّتِهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لآِدَمَ انْظُرْ مَا ذَا تَرَی قَالَ فَنَظَرَ آدَمُ (علیه السلام) إِلَی ذُرِّیَّتِهِ وَ هُمْ ذَرٌّ قَدْ مَلَئُوا السَّمَاءَ قَالَ آدَمُ (علیه السلام) یَا رَبِّ مَا أَکْثَرَ ذُرِّیَّتِی وَ لِأَمْرٍ مَا خَلَقْتَهُمْ فَمَا تُرِیدُ مِنْهُمْ بِأَخْذِکَ الْمِیثَاقَ عَلَیْهِمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ یَعْبُدُونَنِی لا یُشْرِکُونَ بِی شَیْئاً وَ یُؤْمِنُونَ بِرُسُلِی وَ یَتَّبِعُونَهُمْ قَالَ آدَمُ (علیه السلام) یَا رَبِّ فَمَا لِی أَرَی بَعْضَ الذَّرِّ أَعْظَمَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ وَ بَعْضَهُمْ لَهُ نُورٌ کَثِیرٌ وَ بَعْضَهُمْ لَهُ نُورٌ قَلِیلٌ وَ بَعْضَهُمْ لَیْسَ لَهُ نُورٌ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ کَذَلِکَ خَلَقْتُهُمْ لِأَبْلُوَهُمْ فِی کُلِّ حَالاتِهِمْ قَالَ آدَمُ (علیه السلام) یَا رَبِّ فَتَأْذَنُ لِی فِی الْکَلَامِ فَأَتَکَلَّمَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ تَکَلَّمْ فَإِنَّ رُوحَکَ مِنْ رُوحِی وَ طَبِیعَتَکَ {مِنْ} خِلَافِ کَیْنُونَتِی قَالَ آدَمُ یَا رَبِّ فَلَوْ کُنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُمْ عَلَی مِثَالٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ قَدْرٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ طَبِیعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَ جِبِلَّةٍ وَاحِدَةً وَ أَلْوَانٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَ أَعْمَارٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَ أَرْزَاقٍ سَوَاءٍ لَمْ یَبْغِ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَی بَعْضٍ وَ لَمْ یَکُنْ بَیْنَهُمْ تَحَاسُدٌ وَ لَا تَبَاغُضٌ وَ لَا اخْتِلَافٌ فِی شَیْءٍ مِنَ الْأَشْیَاءِ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یَا آدَمُ بِرُوحِی نَطَقْتَ وَ بِضَعْفِ طَبِیعَتِکَ تَکَلَّفْتَ مَا لَا عِلْمَ لَکَ بِهِ وَ أَنَا الْخَالِقُ الْعَالِمُ بِعِلْمِی خَالَفْتُ بَیْنَ خَلْقِهِمْ وَ بِمَشِیئَتِی یَمْضِی فِیهِمْ أَمْرِی وَ إِلَی تَدْبِیرِی وَ تَقْدِیرِی صَائِرُونَ لَا تَبْدِیلَ لِخَلْقِی إِنَّمَاخَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَ الْإِنْسَ لِیَعْبُدُونِ وَ خَلَقْتُ الْجَنَّةَ لِمَنْ أَطَاعَنِی وَ عَبَدَنِی مِنْهُمْ وَ اتَّبَعَ رُسُلِی وَ لَا أُبَالِی وَ خَلَقْتُ النَّارَ لِمَنْ کَفَرَ بِی وَ عَصَانِی وَ لَمْ یَتَّبِعْ رُسُلِی وَ لَا أُبَالِی وَ خَلَقْتُکَ وَ خَلَقْتُ ذُرِّیَّتَکَ مِنْ غَیْرِ فَاقَةٍ بِی إِلَیْکَ وَ إِلَیْهِمْ وَ إِنَّمَا خَلَقْتُکَ وَ خَلَقْتُهُمْ لِأَبْلُوَکَ وَ أَبْلُوَهُمْ أَیُّکُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا، فِی دَارِ الدُّنْیَا فِی حَیَاتِکُمْ وَ قَبْلَ مَمَاتِکُمْ فَلِذَلِکَ خَلَقْتُ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْآخِرَةَ وَ الْحَیَاةَ وَ الْمَوْتَ وَ الطَّاعَةَ وَ الْمَعْصِیَةَ وَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ النَّارَ وَ کَذَلِکَ أَرَدْتُ فِی تَقْدِیرِی وَ تَدْبِیرِی وَ بِعِلْمِیَ النَّافِذِ فِیهِمْ خَالَفْتُ بَیْنَ صُوَرِهِمْ وَ أَجْسَامِهِمْ وَ أَلْوَانِهِمْ وَ أَعْمَارِهِمْ وَ أَرْزَاقِهِمْ وَ طَاعَتِهِمْ وَ مَعْصِیَتِهِمْ فَجَعَلْتُ مِنْهُمُ الشَّقِیَّ وَ السَّعِیدَ وَ الْبَصِیرَ وَ الْأَعْمَی وَ الْقَصِیرَ وَ الطَّوِیلَ وَ الْجَمِیلَ وَ الدَّمِیمَ وَ الْعَالِمَ وَ الْجَاهِلَ وَ الْغَنِیَّ وَ الْفَقِیرَ وَ الْمُطِیعَ وَ الْعَاصِیَ وَ الصَّحِیحَ وَ السَّقِیمَ وَ مَنْ بِهِ الزَّمَانَةُ وَ مَنْ لَا عَاهَةَ بِهِ فَیَنْظُرُ الصَّحِیحُ إِلَی الَّذِی بِهِ الْعَاهَةُ فَیَحْمَدُنِی عَلَی عَافِیَتِهِ وَ یَنْظُرُ الَّذِی بِهِ الْعَاهَةُ إِلَی الصَّحِیحِ فَیَدْعُونِی وَ یَسْأَلُنِی أَنْ أُعَافِیَهُ وَ یَصْبِرُ عَلَی بَلَائِی فَأُثِیبُهُ جَزِیلَ عَطَائِی وَ یَنْظُرُ الْغَنِیُّ إِلَی الْفَقِیرِ فَیَحْمَدُنِی وَ یَشْکُرُنِی وَ یَنْظُرُ الْفَقِیرُ إِلَی الْغَنِیِّ فَیَدْعُونِی وَ یَسْأَلُنِی وَ یَنْظُرُ الْمُؤْمِنُ إِلَی الْکَافِرِ فَیَحْمَدُنِی عَلَی مَا هَدَیْتُهُ فَلِذَلِکَ خَلَقْتُهُمْ لِأَبْلُوَهُمْ فِی السَّرَّاءِ وَ الضَّرَّاءِ وَ فِیمَا أُعَافِیهِمْ وَ فِیمَا أَبْتَلِیهِمْ وَ فِیمَا أُعْطِیهِمْ وَ فِیمَا أَمْنَعُهُمْ وَ أَنَا اللَّهُ الْمَلِکُ الْقَادِرُ وَ لِی أَنْ أَمْضِیَ جَمِیعَ مَا قَدَّرْتُ عَلَی مَا دَبَّرْتُ وَ لِی أَنْ أُغَیِّرَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ مَا شِئْتُ إِلَی مَا شِئْتُ وَ أُقَدِّمَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ مَا أَخَّرْتُ وَ أُؤَخِّرَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَ أَنَا اللَّهُ الْفَعَّالُ لِمَا أُرِیدُ لَا أُسْأَلُ عَمَّا أَفْعَلُ وَ أَنَا أَسْأَلُ خَلْقِی عَمَّا هُمْ فَاعِلُونَ.
56.en: When Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, brought forth the progeny of Adam (peace be upon him) from his loins to take from them the covenant of His Lordship and the prophethood of every prophet, the first for whom He took the covenant of prophethood was Muhammad ibn Abdullah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family). Then Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said to Adam, "Look at what you see." Adam (peace be upon him) looked at his progeny, and they were like tiny particles filling the sky. Adam (peace be upon him) said, "O Lord, how numerous my progeny is! For what great purpose did You create them, and what do You intend by taking this covenant from them?" Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said, "They shall worship Me, not associating anything with Me, and they shall believe in My messengers and follow them." Adam (peace be upon him) said, "O Lord, why do I see some of these particles greater than others, some having much light, some having little light, and some having no light at all?" Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said, "Thus I created them, so that I may test them in all their states." Adam (peace be upon him) said, "O Lord, will You permit me to speak?" Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said, "Speak, for your spirit is from My spirit, and your nature is distinct from My Essence." Adam said, "O Lord, had You created them upon a single model, a single measure, a single nature, a single constitution, identical colors, identical lifespans, and equal provisions, then none would have transgressed against another, and there would have been no envy, hatred, or disagreement among them in any matter." Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said, "O Adam, you have spoken with My spirit, but through the weakness of your nature, you have ventured into that of which you have no knowledge. I am the Creator, the All-Knowing; by My knowledge, I have differentiated between their creation, and by My will, My command proceeds upon them. They are destined for My management and decree; there is no changing My creation. I have only created the jinn and mankind to worship Me. I created Paradise for those among them who obey Me, worship Me, and follow My messengers, and I do not care. I created the Fire for those who disbelieve in Me, disobey Me, and do not follow My messengers, and I do not care. I created you and your progeny without any need for you or them; I only created you and them to test you and them as to which of you is best in deed in the abode of the world, during your life and before your death. For this, I created the world and the Hereafter, life and death, obedience and disobedience, Paradise and the Fire. Thus I willed in My decree and management, and by My knowledge that penetrates them, I differentiated between their forms, bodies, colors, lifespans, provisions, obedience, and disobedience. Consequently, I made among them the wretched and the happy, the sighted and the blind, the short and the tall, the beautiful and the ugly, the learned and the ignorant, the rich and the poor, the obedient and the disobedient, the healthy and the sick, those with disabilities and those without. Thus, the healthy person looks at the one with a disability and praises Me for his well-being, and the one with a disability looks at the healthy person and calls upon Me, asking Me to grant him well-being, and he remains patient through My trial, so I reward him with My abundant bounty. The rich person looks at the poor and praises and thanks Me, and the poor person looks at the rich and calls upon Me and asks of Me. The believer looks at the disbeliever and praises Me for having guided him. For this, I created them: to test them in ease and hardship, in what I grant them of well-being and what I test them with, and in what I give them and what I withhold from them. I am Allah, the King, the Powerful, and it is Mine to execute all that I have decreed according to My management. It is Mine to change of that what I will to what I will, to advance what I have delayed, and to delay what I have advanced. I am Allah, the Doer of what I will; I am not questioned about what I do, but I shall question My creation about what they are doing."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 156

56.ar: صُحُفِ مُوسَی بْنِ عِمْرَانَ (علیه السلام) یَا عِبَادِی إِنِّی لَمْ أَخْلُقْ لِأَسْتَکْثِرَ بِهِمْ مِنْ قِلَّةٍ وَ لَا لِآنَسَ بِهِمْ مِنْ وَحْشَةٍ وَ لَا لِأَسْتَعِینَ بِهِمْ عَلَی شَیْءٍ عَجَزْتُ عَنْهُ وَ لَا لِجَرِّ مَنْفَعَةٍ وَ لَا لِدَفْعِ مَضَرَّةٍ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ جَمِیعَ خَلْقِی مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَی طَاعَتِی وَ عِبَادَتِی لَا یَفْتُرُونَ عَنْ ذَلِکَ لَیْلًا وَ لَا نَهَاراً مَا زَادَ ذَلِکَ فِی مُلْکِی شَیْئاً سُبْحَانِی وَ تَعَالَیْتُ عَنْ ذَلِکَ.
56.fa: خداوند عزّوجلّ در صحف موسی‌بن‌عمران (علیه السلام) فرموده: ای بندگان من! شما را نیافریدم تا بدین‌وسیله از تنهایی و کمی در آمده و صاحب یاور و جماعت زیادی شوم و نه با شما انس گرفته تا به‌واسطه‌ی آن وحشت نکنم و نه به کمک شما عجز خود را ترمیم نمایم و نیز آفرینش شما نه به خاطر جلب منفعت یا دفع ضرر از خودم می‌باشد و همین‌قدر بدانید که اگر تمام مخلوقات من در آسمان و زمین پشت به هم داده و اطاعت و عبادت مرا نموده و شب و روز بدون کوچک‌ترین سستی من را پرستش کنند به سلطنت و قدرتم چیزی افزوده نمی‌شود چه آنکه ساحت ربوبی من والاتر از آن بوده و از این نواقص مبرّا است».
56.en: In the Scrolls of Moses, son of Imran (peace be upon him), God Almighty said: "O My servants! I did not create you to increase My numbers from a state of fewness, nor to find company with you to escape loneliness, nor to seek your help for something I am incapable of, nor to draw any benefit, nor to repel any harm. If all My creation from the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth were to gather together in My obedience and worship, and were not to slacken from that night or day, it would not add anything to My dominion. Glory be to Me, and I am exalted far above that."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 160
56.refs: 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 13; Bahr al-'Irfan, Vol. 11, p. 278

56.ar: مَعْنَاهُ إِلَّا لِیُقِرُّوا بِالْعُبُودِیَّةِ طَوْعاً وَ کَرْهاً.
56.fa: جز برای اینکه به میل خود یا به اکراه، به عبودیّت اقرار کنند.
56.en: Its meaning is: except that they may acknowledge servitude, whether willingly or unwillingly.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 160

56.ar: بِعِبَادَتِنَا عُبِدَ اللَّهُ وَ لَوْ لَا نَحْنُ مَا عُبِدَ اللَّه.
56.fa: با عبادت ما خدا پرستش گردید و اگر ما نبودیم، خدا پرستیده نمی‌شد.
56.en: Through our worship, God was worshipped, and had it not been for us, God would not have been worshipped.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 160
56.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 144; Bahr al-'Irfan, Vol. 15, p. 47

57.ar: ما أُرِیدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَ إِنِّی لَمْ أَخْلُقْهُمْ لِحَاجَةٍ بِی إِلَیْهِمْ.
57.fa: مَا أُرِیدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ؛ یعنی اینکه آن‌ها را به این دلیل خلق نکردم که به آن‌ها نیاز داشتم.
57.en: "I do not desire any provision from them," meaning: I did not create them because I had a need for them.
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 15, p. 160
